design.band_convention: b cycles per 32 samples; tone amplitude A_TONE sqrt(2)
design.degenerate_slice: patch-degenerate iff b/2 integer (identical consecutive patches); trained {2,4,8,16} (b/2 a divisor of 16), untrained {6,10,14}; b=16 is the 32-sample read-out Nyquist and is excluded from verdicts
design.odd_bands: odd b (3,5,7,9,11,13,15) are NOT patch-degenerate for Bolt (half-integer cycles per 16-patch); they are nulled by the model's near-zero low-pass floor instead
design.share_meaning: power fraction; tone amplitude = A_TONE * sqrt(share)
design.partner_note: trained partner = the other host; const = constant offset of value sqrt(.5) (removed by Bolt's instance-norm mean subtraction)
design.controls: pure host at share 1 (A=1) and pure host at share .5 (dilution: the matched standardised-host-content reference; under a linear read-out S_mix = S_dilution, i.e. S_mix / S_pure(same share) = 1)
design.dose: {4+6}: host share in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75), partner the rest
design.phase_combos: 3: combo 0 all-zero, 1+ seeded uniform draws (seed 20261011 + 977*(k+1) + n_components); Part-1 phases seeded per band as SEED_BASE + 10b
design.S_metric: S = fine-spectrum band power at the exact frequency (head_direction.spectrum_at) on Bolt's full 64-step output patch; a unit-power tone reads 1; lobe ~2x narrower than the 32-sample r
design.r32_metric: probe_bolt convention: ||P_b yhat||^2 / ||P_b y||^2 on the 32-sample horizon against the exact continuation
design.bolt_normalisation: InstanceNorm (per-window mean/std) before patching, head output multiplied by the same loc/scale afterwards; no arcsinh

part3_state.state: encoder last-patch token (emb[:, -2]; REG token at emb[:, -1])

PB1_scan_matches_coarse_table.note: b=12 is in neither the trained nor the untrained degenerate set and reads a partial retention (TimesFM-like 3/9/12 partial band)

PB2_untrained_degenerate_partners_drag_h.note: no interference reads 1; <1 is a drag on the trained host band

PB5_odd_nulls_interfere_open.note: open (no directional claim); the odd partners are not on Bolt's patch-degenerate slice, so any drag is not a degeneracy effect
